title: Qdrant: RFC chunks are stored with real embeddings
summary: Chunks 10 IETF RFC text files and writes them to the Qdrant collection rfcs, then checks the collection shape, point count, payloads and text search. Known defect: the Qdrant sink stores zero-vector placeholders, not embeddings, so the real-embedding check is expected to fail and semantic search is impossible.

steps.title: Delete the rfcs collection
steps.explain: Starts clean so every point found later was written by this run.

steps.title: List the source RFC files
steps.explain: The documents a correct run must cover.

steps.title: Collection info (Before)
steps.explain: Before the run the collection does not exist.

steps.title: Run the qdrant_rfcs pipeline
steps.explain: Runs the real pipeline. Everything below checks what it produced.

steps.title: Job finished with status COMPLETED
steps.explain: PARTIAL means some part of the work failed.

steps.title: Job reported 0 warnings
steps.explain: Each warning is a document or step that went wrong.

steps.title: Collection info (After)
steps.explain: The collection the sink created.

steps.title: The collection exists
steps.explain: The sink must create the collection itself.

steps.title: Vector size is 384
steps.explain: Matches vector_size in the pipeline; a wrong size would reject every point.

steps.title: Distance is Cosine
steps.explain: The usual metric for text embeddings.

steps.title: The collection holds points
steps.explain: An empty collection would mean nothing was loaded.

steps.title: Point count equals the chunks the job reported
steps.explain: Every chunk the job counted should be exactly one point, no losses or doubles.

steps.title: Scan every point
steps.explain: Reads all points once to check payloads and vectors.

steps.title: Every point has a payload
steps.explain: A point without payload cannot be traced back to a document.

steps.title: Every point carries chunk text
steps.explain: The text is what a RAG query would return.

steps.title: Every point names its source file
steps.explain: Needed to cite which RFC a hit came from.

steps.title: Every RFC file has points
steps.explain: Names any RFC that was read but did not arrive.

steps.title: Find chunks containing "three-way handshake"
steps.explain: Real embeddings cannot be queried here, so this uses a payload text filter instead of semantic search.

steps.title: A hit comes from rfc793.txt (TCP)
steps.explain: The phrase defines TCP connection setup, so the original TCP RFC must match.

steps.title: Vectors are real embeddings (not all zero)
steps.explain: Without embeddings, semantic search returns nothing meaningful. Counts points whose vector is all zeros; expected 0.
